import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='BMI Category', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.RdYlGn([(x - occupation_sleep.min()) / (occupation_sleep.max() - occupation_sleep.min()) 
                         for x in occupation_sleep.values])
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(x=df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label='Overall Mean')
ax2.legend(loc='lower right')

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity with Sleep Disorder indication
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['Sleep Disorder Clean'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                hue='Sleep Disorder Clean', palette='Set1', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress Level vs Physical Activity by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', 
               palette='Set2', ax=ax4, legend=False)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', color='black', 
              alpha=0.3, size=3, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add mean annotations
for i, gender in enumerate(df['Gender'].unique()):
    mean_val = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Sleep Duration'].mean()
    ax4.annotate(f'Mean: {mean_val:.2f}h', xy=(i, mean_val), 
                xytext=(i + 0.3, mean_val + 0.3),
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='darkblue')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
